response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) as count_orders FROM orders o INNER JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(count_orders) as avg_count_val FROM order_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT oc.count_orders, oc.count_orders - ac.avg_count_val as excess FROM order_counts oc CROSS JOIN avg_count ac WHERE oc.count_orders > ac.avg_count_val) SELECT AVG(count_orders) as avg_of_counts, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM above_avg;

assumptions.assumption: If no order type has a count strictly greater than the average count across all types, the result will be an empty set (zero rows). The request does not specify fallback behavior in this case.
